name: How do I create a budget for my home renovation, and what factors should I consider?

mainEntity.name: How do I create a budget for my home renovation, and what factors should I consider?

acceptedAnswer.text: To create a home renovation budget, start by listing all desired improvements and researching average costs for similar projects in areas like Garden City or Meridian. Factor in not just materials and labor, but also permits, design fees, and a contingency fund, typically 10-20% of the total, for unforeseen issues. It's helpful to prioritize your renovations to allocate funds effectively. Consider what elements are essential versus what are 'nice-to-haves' to make informed decisions if adjustments are needed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Budget by listing improvements, researching costs, and including permits, design fees, and a 10-20% contingency fund.
